task.ques: Find store in arXiv Help, tell me how many styles of arXiv Logo Shirt are available?

claude.final_answer: FINAL: The arXiv Logo Shirt is available in 3 styles: Premium Unisex Tee, Premium Long Sleeve Tee, and Midweight Pullover Hoodie. Evidence: arXiv’s official store, linked from arXiv Help’s Branded Merchandise page, lists all three under “arXiv Logo Shirt”: https://www.bonfire.com/store/arxiv-official/ (checked October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
